correctness.rationale: A direct blockwise construction and necessity argument prove regularity iff either quotient map is bijective or its two source images in one block are nested. Independent image-set surjection counts produce the polynomial coefficients and the M1/M2/intersection formulas from documented definitions. The concentration bound uses a 1-Lipschitz occupancy statistic with expectation at most 3m/4 for m≥2. Exhaustive count for m=2,3,4 (265124 transformations) and direct inverse search for m=2,3 corroborate all coefficients. No finite computation substitutes for the general proof.

value.rationale: The latest two-maximal-subsemigroup theorem leaves their quantitative sizes unexplained. This result computes every rank coefficient of both semigroups and their overlap and proves a qualitative asymptotic separation: one contains almost all regular elements, the other an exponentially vanishing share, while regular elements themselves have limiting density one half. These are natural complete invariants of a studied infinite monoid family, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
